_notes: Everything the videos have used, so the agent reuses before inventing. Status: core (starter kit, build first), requested (invented by a script, not built yet), built, retired. Edit with tools/library.py, not by hand.

assets.name: Event hall
assets.description: A busy networking event: high tables, drinks, warm low light, crowd silhouettes.

assets.name: Drinks table
assets.description: Close corner of the event by the drinks. Two to three people fit comfortably.

assets.name: Stage talk
assets.description: Rows of seats facing a small stage with a speaker and a mic.

assets.name: Coffee shop
assets.description: A two-person table by a window, two cups.

assets.name: Coworking space
assets.description: Desks, laptops, plants, a whiteboard.

assets.name: Phone screen
assets.description: Full-frame phone UI for DMs, texts and profiles. Uses the dm_screen component.

assets.name: Event doorway
assets.description: The entrance to the event, with a lanyard table and the room glowing behind.

assets.name: Street at night
assets.description: Outside after the event: wet pavement, streetlights, walking home.

assets.name: Brand void
assets.description: Plain off-white background with the gold accent. For big statements and cards.

assets.name: Drink glass
assets.description: A stylised glass a character can hold, sip or put down.

assets.name: Phone
assets.description: A character's phone: check it, type, show the screen to camera.

assets.name: Freeze frame
assets.description: Everything stops mid-motion except the narrator's focus.

assets.name: Colour drain
assets.description: The wrong move: the frame drains to cold grey-blue and slows. Part of the locked visual grammar.

assets.name: Gold glow
assets.description: The right move: warm gold light spreads and colour floods back. Part of the locked visual grammar.

assets.name: Whip pan
assets.description: A fast blurred camera swing used as a transition.

assets.name: The answer door
assets.description: When someone tells you something about themselves, a small glowing door appears between you. Ignoring it shuts it, a follow-up opens it into their world.
assets.reuse: Any video about listening, follow-ups, curiosity or missed openings

assets.name: Glowing door
assets.description: A small wooden door, knee height next to a character, with a warm gold glow from the gap underneath. It rises from any surface, shrinks and shuts with a puff of smoke, or swings open onto a new set. A small painted icon on it shows what's behind it.
assets.reuse: The answer door metaphor, any 'opening' or opportunity moment

assets.name: Question cards
assets.description: Two speech bubbles held like playing cards, hand sized, marked with big numbers. One can glow gold, the other crumbles to dust.
assets.reuse: Ranking or comparing lines, first vs second, this vs that

assets.name: Loading spinner
assets.description: A floating grey loading spinner above a character's head, slowly turning, shown while they're bored or stalled.
assets.reuse: Any stalled or boring conversation

assets.name: VHS rewind
assets.description: The whole frame scrubs backwards with VHS tracking lines and a slight colour wobble, then snaps back to normal at a chosen moment.
assets.reuse: Showing the do-over, 'let's try that again'

assets.name: Night kitchen lab
assets.description: A small home kitchen at 2am, lit by one warm lamp, the counter covered in test bottles, handwritten labels and a laptop. Feels like someone's first business.
assets.reuse: Any founder's origin story or side-project moment

assets.name: Interrogation room
assets.description: A dark police interview room with a metal table, two chairs, a swinging overhead lamp and an old tape recorder. Played for comedy, not menace.
assets.reuse: Asking too many questions, being grilled, awkward pressure

assets.name: Ping-pong table
assets.description: A full-size ping-pong table with paddles and a ball that can glow gold, built so the interview table or any table can flip into it.
assets.reuse: Back-and-forth conversation, give and take, trading

assets.name: Study scale grid
assets.description: A huge grid of tiny two-person tables seen from above, each one able to light up warm or go grey, with small tickets that can fly out of chosen tables.
assets.reuse: Showing the size and result of any study with many participants

assets.name: Question bubbles
assets.description: Speech bubbles that float up from conversations like balloons. Grey ones merge into a fog over the room, a gold one can drift to one person and be pocketed.
assets.reuse: Forgettable vs memorable lines, small talk, being remembered

assets.name: Group islands
assets.description: Groups at an event stand on small lit islands in a dark still floor of water; lone people stand on single stepping stones. Joining or starting a group grows an island.
assets.reuse: Any video about groups, belonging, cliques, being left out or starting your own circle

assets.name: Islands floor
assets.description: The event floor turns into dark, still, reflective water. Each group stands on a round lit island just big enough for them, lone people on a knee-high stepping stone. Stones rise under feet as someone walks, and islands can fuse and grow with a soft clunk.
assets.reuse: Groups, isolation, building a circle, bridges between people

assets.name: Event lanyard
assets.description: A fabric neck strap with a plastic badge holder hanging at chest height, blank card with a small gold logo. Swings when the wearer turns.
assets.reuse: Any event, conference or meetup scene, as a quick 'this person is at the event' tell

assets.name: The envelope pile
assets.description: Every message is an envelope landing on someone's desk. Generic ones are identical grey envelopes that pile up unopened. A specific one is a gold, hand-addressed envelope that lands on top.
assets.reuse: Follow-ups, cold DMs, emails, any 'stand out in their inbox' lesson

assets.name: Envelope pile
assets.description: Hand-sized envelopes. Grey ones are plain and identical and stack into a wobbling tower taller than a person that can topple. One gold envelope with a handwritten name and a gold sticker glows softly and can sail through the air and land on top. Any envelope can drain grey or light up gold.
assets.reuse: Inboxes, DMs, follow-ups, outreach volume

assets.name: Endless scroll
assets.description: A long paper scroll that unrolls out of a phone screen, across the floor and out of a door, for a message that's far too long. It can snap back up into the phone in one move.
assets.reuse: Over-long messages, rambling pitches, too much text

assets.name: The fog calendar
assets.description: A vague plan is a calendar full of fog with no days on it. A specific time slams a gold pin into one real day and clears the fog around it.
assets.reuse: Any video about vague plans, 'let's catch up', scheduling or follow-through

assets.name: Fog calendar
assets.description: A big paper wall calendar, taller than a character, whose day squares can dissolve into drifting grey fog or clear. A thumb-sized gold pin can slam into one square, glow, be pulled out and moved, or drop and bounce. Pages flip to show time passing.
assets.reuse: Scheduling, time passing, deadlines, vague plans

assets.name: Runaway coffee cup
assets.description: A takeaway coffee cup with a lid, about knee height, with two little legs. It trots away when chased, and trots back and sits when you stop. Can be steaming hot or cold and abandoned.
assets.reuse: Coffee meetings, chasing people, plans that keep getting away

assets.name: The echo cave
assets.description: A conversation is a cave. Tossing someone's own words back makes them echo off the walls and light lanterns deeper in, revealing their story painted on the walls.
assets.reuse: Listening, going deeper, follow-ups, getting someone to open up

assets.name: Echo cave
assets.description: A warm stone cave whose walls can rise out of any floor. A tunnel runs back into darkness with a row of hanging lanterns that light one by one. The walls can show simple painted scenes, like cave paintings, that appear as the lanterns light.
assets.reuse: Going deeper in a conversation, someone's backstory, discovery

assets.name: Word tiles
assets.description: Chunky tiles, each with one spoken word in bold letters, about the size of a hand. They float out of a speaker's mouth in a line, can be picked up and tossed, thud and turn grey when ignored, or ring and glow gold when they matter.
assets.reuse: Any lesson about specific words, what to say, what to repeat or cut

assets.name: The two scorecards
assets.description: After a conversation, both people hold up judge's score paddles. You score yourself from a blooper reel, they score you from a highlight reel, and your number is always lower.
assets.reuse: Self-doubt, overthinking, first impressions, how others really see you

assets.name: Score paddles
assets.description: Round white judge's paddles on a short handle, held at head height, with one big number. The number can flip, glow gold, drain grey, or drop out of a hand.
assets.reuse: Ratings, judgements, self-assessment vs reality

assets.name: Reel screens
assets.description: A small floating screen above a character's head, like a thought bubble, playing short clips of a moment. A grey blooper version and a gold highlight version. Can also play on any surface, like a fogged mirror.
assets.reuse: Memories, replaying moments, overthinking, what someone remembers

assets.name: Flat-pack vs parcel
assets.description: A request that makes someone do the work is a flat-pack box with loose parts and instructions. A request you've done the work for is a wrapped parcel ready to send.
assets.reuse: Any ask, intro, favor or request where making it easy is the lesson

assets.name: Intro parcel
assets.description: A box that has two states. Flat-pack: a big brown cardboard box, chest high, with loose parts rattling and a thick instruction booklet, which can spill or gather dust. Wrapped: a neat gold-ribboned parcel, shoebox sized, with a handwritten label and a small gold pull tab on the side.
assets.reuse: Asks, favors, gifts, intros, deliverables

assets.name: Forward button
assets.description: A big round arcade-style button, about knee height, gold with a forward arrow on top. A parcel or message sits on it and shoots off with a whoosh and a gold trail when it's pressed.
assets.reuse: Sharing, forwarding, sending, making something one tap

assets.name: The conveyor belt
assets.description: Doing what everyone does puts you on a factory conveyor belt: you get processed the same way as everyone else and dropped off the end, forgotten. Stepping off it is the move.
assets.reuse: Queues, mass outreach, generic DMs, anything where everyone does the same thing

assets.name: Queue conveyor
assets.description: A floor or aisle turns into a grey industrial conveyor belt carrying people in a line. At the end, a stamp marks each person and they drop into a bin of identical grey faces. The belt can grind to a halt with a clunk.
assets.reuse: Queues, processes, being one of many, standing out from the line

assets.name: Notebook
assets.description: A hand-sized notebook with a pen clipped on, pages that flutter and turn, and underlined lines that can glow gold. Two notebooks can swap pages through the air.
assets.reuse: Talks, learning, comparing notes, preparation

assets.name: The energy line
assets.description: A glowing heart-monitor line floats over a conversation, rising with laughs and sagging when it goes flat. A polaroid snaps whatever it's doing at the end, and that's the memory kept.
assets.reuse: Endings, first and last impressions, timing, reading energy

assets.name: Energy line
assets.description: A thick glowing line floating above two characters like a heart-monitor trace. It glows gold and climbs on laughs, sags and turns grey when the talk goes flat, and can beep flat. Can also be drawn small over any object.
assets.reuse: Conversation energy, mood, momentum, before and after

assets.name: Memory polaroid
assets.description: A hand-sized instant photo that snaps out of the air with a flash and shows the last moment of something. It can slide into a pocket, glow gold or drain grey.
assets.reuse: What people remember, first impressions, last impressions, highlights

assets.name: The dormant attic
assets.description: Your old contacts are figures asleep under dust sheets in an attic. Reaching out pulls the sheet off and they wake up glowing.
assets.reuse: Reconnecting, old clients, your existing network, past relationships

assets.name: Contact attic
assets.description: A warm wooden attic with sloped beams, dusty floorboards, a small round window and a pull-down ladder. Rows of figures stand or sit under white dust sheets. It can be dark and torch-lit or warm and glowing once people wake up.
assets.reuse: Old contacts, memories, forgotten ideas, things you already have

assets.name: Dust sheets
assets.description: White cloth sheets draped over a standing or sitting figure, slightly dusty, that can twitch, lift at the corner or slide off in one smooth pull to reveal the person underneath waking up.
assets.reuse: Reveals, dormant things, waking something up

assets.name: Double-dutch
assets.description: Joining a conversation is jumping into two turning skipping ropes. The ropes open on the beat, the laugh, and you hop in clean.
assets.reuse: Timing, joining groups, interrupting well, knowing when to speak

assets.name: Double-dutch ropes
assets.description: Two long glowing skipping ropes turning around a group of characters with no one holding them. They sweep the floor in a steady beat, swing wide open in slow motion on a cue, wobble and slow when the energy drops, and glow gold when it's good.
assets.reuse: Group rhythm, timing, momentum, joining in

assets.name: Story baton
assets.description: A short relay baton, hand-sized, that glows gold. Passing it hands over the turn to speak, and it glows brighter when someone's on a roll.
assets.reuse: Turn-taking, handing the floor to someone, letting others shine
